QUOTE: Fuzzy rows are kept in `callers` on purpose: this repo has 21.3% fuzzy edges, and entropic has 79.8%. The `dominated_edges.py` pass only removes fan-out when a stronger layer already named a different function at that call site.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says fuzzy edges are kept in callers but never contrasts this with a traversal surface that excludes them, and gives no reason that a walk multiplies one fuzzy edge into a wrong subtree.
